easy_question: Never mind how well it is drawn. Does this picture show a road junction seen from above with white markings painted on the carriageway. A photograph, a rendering or a scan of one all count as yes. Answer no only if the image instead shows a bare card stating an answer with none of that around it, or shows something unrelated. Answer yes or no only.

steps.target: a patch of white paint holding block capitals with an arrow beside them

steps.read_crop: Taking twelve o'clock as the top of the picture, look at one single letter of the block capitals in this cut-out. That letter is stretched along one direction. Which hour of a clock face does that stretch run toward? Answer with a whole number from 1 to 12 and nothing else.
Taking twelve o'clock as the top of the picture, which hour of a clock face does the head of the painted arrow in this cut-out point toward. Answer with a whole number from 1 to 12.

steps.target: a patch of white paint holding block capitals laid on the carriageway

steps.read_crop: Look at the shape of a single letter in this cut-out, not at the whole word. Is that letter more than twice as long in one direction as it is in the other, or is it about as long one way as the other. Answer with the word stretched or the word ordinary.

steps.target: a figure in millimetres or a written note laid on the carriageway
